title: Policy
description: A decision about the Actions it names: allow, deny, route the work to another performer, or require someone else's approval, when its condition holds or always when it has none. A rule on an Action's input is a policy whose condition reads input, so permissions and business rules are written in one grammar.

id.description: Kebab-case. Unique among the policies of its behaviour document.

description.description: What the policy decides and why. A refusal cites it.

actions.description: The Actions it governs: in this behaviour document, or behaviour/action for one in a document this one uses.

when.description: When the effect applies. Without it, the effect always applies.

oneOf.description: route reassigns the work. require_approval leaves it with the requester and gates it on someone else's authorization.

performer.description: The kind of performer the work goes to.

refs.description: Any one of these performers satisfies the effect. Absent pins nobody specific.
